comparison.objective: Select a reach rod, insert it through a service port, and hold a guarded reset button depressed; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-668 tests tool selection, long-rod grasping, port alignment, reach extension, and sustained axial pressing; the candidate tests coaxial driver/wrench engagement and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-668 requires the rod through the port and the button depressed at least 5 mm for one second; the candidate requires a locked target angle retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Remote button actuation through a barrier is a different tested ability from mechanical calibration and locknut tightening.
